svg.aria-label: Superior gluteal, inferior gluteal and sciatic nerves: posterior anatomy — 臀上神经、臀下神经与坐骨神经：后面实体解剖

text.aria-label: Superior gluteal, inferior gluteal and sciatic nerves: posterior anatomy — 臀上神经、臀下神经与坐骨神经：后面实体解剖
text.tspan: Superior gluteal, inferior gluteal and sciatic nerves: posterior anatomy
臀上神经、臀下神经与坐骨神经：后面实体解剖

text.aria-label: Superior gluteal nerve — 臀上神经
Inferior gluteal nerve — 臀下神经
Common fibular nerve — 腓总神经
Gemelli, obturator internus, quadratus femoris — 孖肌、闭孔内肌、股方肌
Gluteus maximus (transparent) — 臀大肌（半透明）
Course, step by step — 走行步骤

svg.text: 臀上神经（L4–S1）在梨状肌上方出盆。
It runs between gluteus medius and minimus
它在臀中肌与臀小肌之间走到阔筋膜张肌。
臀下神经（L5–S2）在梨状肌下方出盆，进入臀大肌。
坐骨神经（L4–S3）在梨状肌下方出盆。
It crosses the gemelli, obturator internus
它越过孖肌、闭孔内肌和股方肌，
then splits above the knee into tibial and
在膝上方分为胫神经和腓总神经。

text.aria-label: Step 1–2 = superior gluteal; 3 = inferior gluteal; — 第 1–2 步为臀上神经；第 3 步为臀下神经；
text.tspan: 第 1–2 步为臀上神经；第 3 步为臀下神经；

text.aria-label: 4–6 = sciatic nerve. — 第 4–6 步为坐骨神经。

text.tspan: Schematic; pathway and layers are simplified.
解剖示意；走行与层次经过简化。
